behavior: Pasting one HTTPS link into a new owner resource form reads page details automatically. Name, description, folder, type, tags and an available page image are suggested before private save.
editing: Owner-edited values and selected folders are preserved. Changing links clears only imported values, aborts the earlier request, and rejects stale responses. Bulk links and imports keep their existing flow.
images: The form receives a sanitized WebP data preview rather than loading an untrusted remote image in the browser. Saving copies a validated page image into existing private media storage. Image failure falls back without losing the resource.
network: Owner-only, same-origin endpoint. HTTPS only, public DNS answers pinned per request, redirects revalidated, no cookies forwarded. Ten-second read budget, 512KB page limit and 4MB image limit. Existing X oEmbed handling retained.
limits: Reads HTML metadata and visible source text without running page scripts. Blocked or JavaScript-only pages can require manual entry. Folder, type and tags are editable suggestions. Metadata does not save or publish a resource automatically.

Tests cover private and mixed DNS, redirect-to-private denial, response size limits, sanitized image previews, image fallback, manual field preservation and stale results.
chrome: Verified URL paste autofill, manual name preservation after a metadata refresh, local private save with stored thumbnail, and 390px form fit without horizontal overflow. Viewport override reset.
